warrior-of-the-mystic-arts.summary: A monk who blends martial discipline with sorcery, trading Focus Points and spell slots back and forth.

Spellcasting.summary: Third-caster on the Sorcerer list with WIS: 2 cantrips (3 at Monk 10) and 3 prepared level 1+ spells at Monk 3, rising to 13 by Monk 20 with slots up to level 4. An Arcane Focus works as your focus; swap one cantrip and one spell each Monk level.

Mystic Fighting Style.summary: When you take the Attack action, one Unarmed Strike can become a casting of a 1-action Sorcerer cantrip.

Mystic Focus.summary: Spend a spell slot (no action) to regain Focus Points equal to its level. On a Short Rest or Uncanny Metabolism, pay Focus Points for one spent slot: level 1 for 2 (Monk 6), 2 for 3 (Monk 7), 3 for 5 (Monk 13), 4 for 6 (Monk 19).

Focused Strike.summary: Whatever the result of your Stunning Strike's save, that target has Disadvantage on saves against your spells until your next turn starts.
Focused Strike.duration: until the start of your next turn

Improved Mystic Fighting Style.summary: With Flurry of Blows, swap two of its Unarmed Strikes for a 1-action level 1 or 2 Sorcerer spell, cast within that same Bonus Action.
